# Phase One File Graph — Theoretical Before Commitment

The Awtsmoos gives each module a vessel small and bright; Awtsmoos.com joins them by contracts rather than monolithic might.

## Canonical candidate
`apps/shared/movie/`

## Theoretical files that may be involved
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieKinds.js` — canonical semantic kinds.
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieProtocol.js` — canonical document and seconds unit.
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieCapabilities.js` — all app personalities and truthful strengths.
- `apps/shared/movie/AiMovieContract.js` — machine-readable AI authoring covenant.
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieNormalizer.js` — stable IDs/defaults.
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieValidator.js` — timing, IDs and semantic guards.
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentCompiler.js` — structured intent compiler if peers lack an equivalent.
- `apps/shared/movie/adapters/ProjectionReport.js` — shared fidelity report.
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MovieDock.js` and CSS — mobile-first AI authoring dock.
- `apps/shared/movie/examples/ThreeMinuteMovie.js` and its small scene/cast modules — acceptance specification.
- `apps/animator/src/movie/AnimatorMovieAdapter.js` — Animator projection.
- `apps/nesher-studio/modules/movie/NesherMovieAdapter.js` — Nesher projection.
- `apps/video-editor/js/movie/VideoEditorMovieAdapter.js` — lightweight timeline projection.
- `apps/mitzvah-studio/modules/movie/MitzvahMovieAdapter.js` — object-authoring projection.
- alternate `shared/movie` and `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core` entry points only as compatibility bridges where import tracing proves need.
- verification modules under `apps/shared/movie/tests/` and a proof renderer/exporter only if no native renderer consumes the canonical document.

## Dependency graph
AI structured intent -> canonical compiler -> normalized movie -> validator -> app capability -> app adapter -> native app model/renderer -> export -> measured proof.

Three-minute example -> validator -> visual renderer -> media file -> ffprobe + frame witnesses.

Alternate prototype core -> compatibility translator -> canonical movie; never two public formats pretending to be identical.

## Write discipline
Prefer new files. Before rewriting any pre-existing file: full read, SHA-256 snapshot, immediate collision recheck, then whole-file atomic replacement only.
